title: session-cartography-instrumentation-notes
content:
Purpose:
This working note maps a compact, investigation-first set of session-level metrics, tracing anchors, and dashboard sketches to reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve for multi-hop inference sessions. It leans on a low-cardinality metric core plus trace anchors for deep dives.

Why this differs from prior lists:
- Focus on session cartography: how tokens move across components across hops, not only single-span latency.
- Emphasis on small, query-cheap dashboard widgets that directly link into traces.
- Explicit microprobe prescriptions that can be toggled per-tenant cohort to control cost.

Core objectives:
- Define 6 core session SLIs that are sufficient for oncall triage.
- Reduce ad-hoc trace queries by surfacing the likely root cause from metrics + probe tags.
- Keep long-term metric cardinality bounded while preserving actionable slices for 30/60/90d economics.

Canonical session SLI candidates (keep short):
- session_ttf_ms_p90: p90 time-to-first-token per session (ms)
- session_p99_tail_count: count of sessions exceeding tail threshold (computed)
- session_error_rate_pct: percent of sessions with any error flag
- session_kv_hit_ratio: per-session fraction of prefix lookups served from cache
- session_token_efficiency: tokens_generated / tokens_requested (useful for noisy prompts)
- session_cost_usd_estimate: quick est. combining model unit costs and token counts

Minimal metric emission rules:
- Emit metrics with tags: model, model_family, region, route, tenant_cohort. Avoid session_id in metric labels except ephemeral aggregated windows where necessary.
- Use uniform latency buckets across services.
- Export session-level aggregates at 1m resolution, and roll into 10m/1h windows for longer retention.

Trace anchors and attribute checklist (for all spans):
- Required: session_id (top-level), trace_sampling_decision, route_id, model_variant
- Router span: include route_hash, route_decision_reason (cache,fallback,canary), queue_depth_at_enqueue
- Model executor spans: include kv_prefix_len, kv_cache_hit (bool), kv_ttl_bucket, decoder_tokens_emitted
- Fanout spans: include fanout_target_count and hop_index (0..n) so multi-hop reconstructions are trivial
- Microprobe spans: probe_type, probe_budget_tag, expected_latency_ms

Sampling guidance (practical):
- Always sample all traces where session_error_flag=true (full detail).
- Targeted tail sampling: probabilistic sampler biased by measured session_first_token_latency percentile (increase probability above 95th percentile).
- Budget floor: keep a small constant reservoir (0.05% of total) to capture random baseline traces for drift detection.

Microprobe catalog (toggleable):
- probe_warm_kv_small: 32-token prefix used to warm small hot keys; success measured by immediate kv_hit on subsequent real session. Budget: 1 probe per tenant_cohort per 15s by default.
- probe_model_light_seq: 12-token generation on cheap variant to approximate scheduler pressure; useful to detect executor starvation.
- probe_route_canary: exercises new route config after deploy with a flagged probe header for easier filtering. Runs at 5x baseline for first 3 minutes post-rollout.

Dashboard concept (compact operator layout):
- Row A (overview): session_p99_tail_count, session_error_rate_pct, global_inference_qps, cost_rate_usd/min
- Row B (session slices): small-heatmap of session_kv_hit_ratio by tenant_cohort, bar for top 10 routes by session_count, p90 TTF by model_family
- Row C (quick triage): recent error sessions table (last 100) with columns: session_id (link), route_id, model_variant, session_ttf_ms_p90, session_cost_estimate, probe_tag if present
- Row D (tail tooling): p99 trace sampler quick-open, fanout distribution histogram, top 10 eviction contributors
- Each widget must include a 1-click "Open trace" action that pre-filters by route_id and session_time window.

Investigation cookbook (starter rules):
- Symptom: high session_ttf but low total tokens: check model_queue wait times then inspect executor spans for cold-init markers.
- Symptom: rising cost_per_session with unchanged latency: inspect session_token_efficiency and recent prompt rewrites; look for unbounded reranking or loop behavior.
- Symptom: kv_hit_ratio collapse for cohort: correlate with eviction counts and ttl_bucket churn; check sidecar logs for mass key evictions.

Retention & cost policy:
- Metrics: high-cardinality tag retention 7d, aggregated metrics 90d.
- Traces: sampled detailed traces 14d, error & p99 traces 90d.
- Microprobe raw responses only stored for 7d to bound storage.

Practical instrumentation snippets (pseudo):
- Metric example: session_kv_hit_ratio{model_family="mistral",region="eu-west-1",tenant_cohort="small-startups"} 0.73
- Span attribute example (pseudo): span.set_attribute("fanout.hop_index", 2); span.set_attribute("kv.cache_hit", false); span.set_attribute("probe.type", "probe_warm_kv_small")

Ownership & rollout plan (short):
- session propagation SDK changes: eng-platform (owner: Elena Park)
- kv instrumentation + eviction events: serving-runtime (owner: Samir Iqbal)
- dashboards + probes orchestration: eng-observability (owner: Noah Martins)
- cost estimation pipeline: eng-data-platform (owner: Jules Park)

Next immediate actions:
- 2-week spike: enable session_id propagation in staging + run sampler for 72h to estimate trace volume impact.
- Configure 3 microprobes for two tenant_cohorts and measure kv_hit_ratio delta and cost.
- Build compact operator dashboard and test 1-click trace drill flows.

Open tradeoffs & questions:
- How to represent tenant privacy if session-level tracing is required? Proposal: ephemeral per-day salted hash for session_id in long term storage.
- Should microprobe cadence be adaptive to peak load? Likely yes, but need safe-guard to avoid probe amplification.

Notes: This is a working living doc; keep edits short and append changelog entries at the bottom.

Changelog:
- 2026-01-20: clarified sampling budget floor and added fanout.hop_index attribute guidance.
- 2025-11-05: initial draft and probe catalog.
